programmes.evidence: Official current Batch 2027 admission policy explicitly lists Operations Management as a selectable doctoral specialization and says successful candidates receive Ph.D. in Management. The official academic-group directory confirms an Operations Management group.
limitations: The official current policy describes the awarded degree as Ph.D. in Management; Operations Management is the formal specialization, not a separate degree.

branches.conclusion: Current Batch 2027 policy verifies formal Operations Management specialization in the Ph.D. in Management. Older official doctoral overview also lists Operations Research & Systems Analysis under a related-discipline stream; this specialization is absent from the current admission-policy list and its present award/admissions status is unresolved, so no second current route is proposed.
Management institute official academic-group inventory has no engineering school or department. Operations Management is an academic group; no engineering PhD route inferred.
